items.title: The science of vaccines is rapidly advancing — despite the anti-vax movement
items.content: Look at the promising data for Moderna and Merck’s experimental cancer vaccine and the research suggesting the shingles vaccine can delay dementia.

items.title: The prostate-cancer screening rules just changed. Here’s when men should get tested.
items.content: The American Cancer Society now recommends most men get their first PSA test when they turn 50. Black men and other men considered high risk should start screening at age 45.

items.title: Nvidia has shed nearly $500 billion in market value this week. It’s still a $4 trillion AI behemoth.
items.content: Can Nvidia keep its lead in AI chips without Jensen Huang? Plus, what investors are watching on inflation.

items.title: I inherited $1.4 million from my father. Am I wrong to ask my husband of 25 years for a postnuptial agreement?
items.content: “He has always said he wants his daughter to inherit a chunk of his estate, and I’ve never objected to that.”

items.title: Microsoft stock slumps on outage that includes the Copilot tool it has been heavily promoting
items.content: Microsoft stock fell in premarket trade Friday as the company struggled to address a worldwide outage of its popular products.

items.title: Profit surprises are normalizing — and that may signal a healthier stock market, say Citi strategists
items.content: Although the majority of S&P 500 companies reported earnings above analysts’ expectations, the beats were significantly lower than in more recent quarters.

items.title: ‘He calls my plans a fantasy’: My husband says we can’t afford our $200,000-a-year dream retirement. I think he’s cheap.
items.content: “We have $2 million saved in our retirement accounts and a house worth $1.3 million.”

items.title: Investors are underestimating AI. But the real challenge is diversification, this strategist says.
items.content: Artificial intelligence is all everyone has talked about since the arrival of ChatGPT, but HSBC’s global chief investment officer thinks investors are still underestimating it.

items.title: ‘She has a history of financial mismanagement’: My brother cut my sister out of his will. I’m getting everything. Do I tell her?
items.content: “I’m torn between respecting my brother’s wishes, being fair to my sister, and preserving a relationship that means a great deal to me.”

items.title: Earnings growth is set to peter out — but not the bull market, says Goldman Sachs. Here’s what the firm recommends.
items.content: Earnings growth is almost halving across major indices in 2027 but stocks have already discounted much of that deceleration. Goldman recommends investors focus closely on those companies still delivering strong growth – as strong growth becomes a scarce commodity.
